```{r}
X16_Retail_Dataset_real <- read.csv("X16_Retail_Dataset_real")
df_limpio <- X16_Retail_Dataset_real %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(Date = ymd(Date))

print(paste("Total de filas limpias:", nrow(df_limpio)))
```
